"""Helper utilities."""

def running_mean(xs):
    """Return the running mean of xs as a list of floats rounded to 2 decimals."""
    means = []
    current_sum = 0.0
    for i, x in enumerate(xs, 1):
        current_sum += x
        means.append(round(current_sum / i, 2))
    return means
